description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, targeting Bond of Insight.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying Bond of Insight.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and return Twincast and any other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
